basic_details.job_title: AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary post of Project Research Scientist- I (Medical) is open under an ICMR funded project at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi (Akhil Bharatiya Ayurvigyan Sansthan, Nai Dilli), with a consolidated salary of Rs. 87,100/-. The essential qualification is MBBS/ BDS and the age limit is 18-35 years. Eligible candidates can submit their application through the online form link given in the notice until 12 November 2026 till 5 PM.

how_to_apply: Applications are made online only. Eligible candidates can submit their application at the link printed in the notice, https://forms.gle/52toqQNdjkJ8EX9b9, until November 12, 2026 till 5 PM. The notice does not list the documents to attach or any further application steps.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi is the institute at which this project post is based. The vacancy notice, dated 02 November 2026, is issued in English and Hindi and is signed by Dr. Yatan Pal Singh Balhara, Professor, Psychiatry & NDDTC, A.I.I.M.S., New Delhi-110029. The post is a temporary one under a project funded by ICMR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age limit: 18-35 years. Age relaxation as per rules. The notice does not mention the date on which age is counted. Experience: Research experience in mental health and addictive disorders is listed as desirable, not essential. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

rows.desirable: Prior experience of research work in the area of mental health and addictive disorders

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist- I (Medical)
content_sections.text: Applications are made online only. Eligible candidates can submit their application at the link printed in the notice, https://forms.gle/52toqQNdjkJ8EX9b9, until November 12, 2026 till 5 PM. The notice does not list the documents to attach or any further application steps.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the date of interview shall be intimated subsequently. The interview mode and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist- I (Medical) recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist- I (Medical) under an ICMR funded project at AIIMS, New Delhi.

faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 12 November 2026 till 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Project Research Scientist- I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS/ BDS. Prior experience of research work in the area of mental health and addictive disorders is desirable.

faq.answer: The age limit is 18-35 years, with age relaxation as per rules.

faq.answer: The notice mentions an interview, and the date of interview shall be intimated subsequently.
